whyThisFilenameAndNotCheckpointsJson: data/rcap-grade-a/packet-factory-24h/pf11/checkpoints.json already holds a PF11 return from an earlier shift, for a different assignment. It is left byte-for-byte unchanged and this shift’s checkpoint is written alongside it.
checkpointRule: The brief asks for a checkpoint every five completed families or every two hours, whichever comes first. This assignment holds three families, so the five-family boundary is never reached and the assignment closes on one checkpoint covering all three.

checkpoints.note: Both built families are BUILT_RASTER_PENDING. That is a factory workflow state and not a launch verdict: it zeroes nothing and waives nothing, and visualDefects records that nobody independent has looked rather than that there is nothing to see.
